researchQuestion: After the one owner-authorised Dusk-exclusive ChoiceScreen fallback is closed at its frozen identity gate, does the exact immutable closure map leave one materially distinct, evidence-backed and product-semantics-complete deterministic mechanism class that can proceed autonomously without reopening a closed family?

scientificBasis.coverageRule: Partition every possible strategy mediator by lifetime and representation: immediate use of existing state, existing combat representation, generated-card representation, player-status representation, a new combat representation, existing run/acquisition representation, the bounded ChoiceScreen representation, a new persistent or presentation representation, or an external learned/random method.
scientificBasis.exhaustivenessBoundary: The partition is exhaustive for the finite #421 representation grammar established by the exact current-main state audit, the two minimum new-mediator audits and the owner-bounded acquisition fallback. It does not claim that every imaginable game mechanic is scientifically impossible.
scientificBasis.selectionRule: A class is autonomously eligible only when it is materially distinct, has no immutable closure, has product semantics already fixed by evidence or the SSOT, needs no human authority, is deterministic and RNG-free, and has method authority where applicable.
scientificBasis.unavailableRule: If no class is autonomously eligible but one or more materially distinct classes require new product semantics or revision of a frozen one-attempt boundary, the relevant gate is unavailable under the current authority rather than scientifically negative.
scientificBasis.noGuessingRule: No card, relic, effect, status, counter, value, carrier, trigger, acquisition route, UI, policy or optimiser may be proposed from an unavailable class in this audit.

design.type: zero-row deterministic representation coverage audit; not a factorial, candidate search, causal contrast or optimiser
design.matrix: Nine mutually exclusive representation classes, each evaluated once against the same exact source, immutable evidence set and authority rules.
anchors: exact current-main source commit and eight source blob identities

estimands.primary: Count and identity of autonomously eligible materially distinct mechanism classes.
estimands.authority: Count and identity of materially distinct classes whose product semantics or frozen-boundary exception are unavailable under current authority.
estimands.notEstimated: No support, reachability, activation, complementarity, viability, policy sensitivity, causal payoff, interference, duration, detector, ML, RL or product endpoint is estimated.

design.interactions: None. The representation classes are coverage units, not treatment factors, and no joint cell is meaningful.

factorDisposition.scorelinePayoff: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied, pooled or reinterpreted.
factorDisposition.afterimagePayoff: Separate fixed causal factor; not varied, pooled or reinterpreted.
factorDisposition.acquisition: The one owner-bounded ChoiceScreen/existing-consumer contract is immutable and closed at identity; no alternate selector, UI, cohort, consumer or encoding is evaluated.
factorDisposition.candidate: No card, relic, effect, value, carrier, trigger, route or UI is selected.
factorDisposition.method: No ML, RL, optimiser, fitted model, random search or adaptive candidate loop is used.

representationPartition.aliasStructure: An immediate new consumer must read an existing state, card-zone, identity, trigger or payoff relation. The exact current-main coverage and finite mediator audits map those relations to Scoreline, Afterimage, direct-zone, cadence, action-economy, Ember, Facet, Shatter or other immutable closures.

The unique minimum private combat card-token form is the exact private-debt design closed by the controlling owner decision at identity v2. A different token, carrier, value or removal rule would reopen the frozen design.

The unique post-card-token private combat status form was frozen once and closed at its necessary carrier-repertoire capacity gate. Another status, carrier, cost or clean-up rule would be an adaptive substitute.

A genuinely new combat representation must define a new counter, transform, tag, target memory, cost or event lifecycle. The SSOT supplies no evidence-backed semantics that choose among these materially different product behaviours after the minimum card-token and status forms close.

Normal reward, shop, event, deed, boss-relic, removal, elite and other current acquisition/trigger surfaces are immutable closed aliases; exact source contains no native deterministic Dusk-exclusive route satisfying the frozen contract.

Comment 5457447279 authorised one bounded Option 2 design. Its unique minimum ChoiceScreen/existing-consumer contract passed direct controls and then closed on its frozen cross-probe content-identity gate with no repair or rerun.

A new run-persistent commitment, ownership state or relic contract needs new product semantics and save/internal-ID treatment not selected by the SSOT. Multiple materially different valid behaviours remain.
A second UI, new choice timing, new consumer set or alternate selector is outside the one owner-bounded fallback and would choose a new player-facing product contract absent from the SSOT.
Every preregistered method-decision signal is false. No measured policy-repertoire bottleneck grants ML, RL, optimiser or random-search authority.

decisionRules.success: All exact identities pass and exactly one representation class satisfies every autonomous-eligibility rule within 30 seconds.
decisionRules.successAuthority: Apply decision boundary 1 and freeze only that one class for a separately preregistered design audit. Do not choose a carrier, value, effect, UI, method, support row or simulator row here.
decisionRules.futility: All exact identities pass, no class is autonomously eligible and at least one materially distinct class requires unavailable product semantics or revision of a frozen boundary.
decisionRules.futilityAuthority: Apply decision boundary 2 and record the relevant structural gate unavailable. Preserve the repository, ledger and protected seeds; publish this zero-row evidence and present one concise human-authority decision package without creating a successor ticket, proposing an unfrozen candidate or declaring autonomous balancing impossible.
decisionRules.inconclusive: Any exact source, task, evidence, partition, ledger or 30-second identity fails, more than one class is autonomously eligible, or no eligible and no human-authority class is identified.
decisionRules.inconclusiveAuthority: Apply decision boundary 3 and record the audit inconclusive at cap without selecting, implementing, simulating, inspecting support, repairing a closed protocol or using a protected seed.

claimBoundary: This audit establishes only whether the finite current #421 representation grammar contains an autonomously selectable next class. It does not establish a universal scientific negative, alter any prior result, accept #421, or authorise a product mechanism.
